target_customer: Contractors and construction material stores in Indonesia that buy raw construction materials
problem: Procuring construction materials in Indonesia relies on many phone calls, text messages and back and forth, with manual price and stock checks, expensive credit, poor delivery visibility and out of stock items caused by a fragmented value chain.
business_model: B2B marketplace with product margin or commission, plus planned buyer credit and manufacturer demand planning

founders.name: Hansel
prior_employers: GudangAda (Senior VP of Strategy and Revenue)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a single name. Launch post cites 10+ years in strategy, sales and operations including construction and manufacturing.

founders.name: Steven Walentino
founders.background_notes: Seven years as a software engineer at Google, Yahoo and Zillow Group per the YC page.

competitors.name: Juragan Material
competitors.what: B2B e-commerce for construction materials aimed at contractors and developers in Indonesia
competitors.funding_then: Seed of about 4 million USD dated July 2022 per a funding tracker

competitors.name: BRIK
competitors.what: B2B raw materials aggregator for Indonesian construction
competitors.funding_then: Initial funding of 59 billion rupiah led by AC Ventures in June 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: A catalog, pricing, ordering and logistics tracking platform is standard marketplace engineering. Hard parts are integrating with fragmented suppliers and building credit scoring from transaction history.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals (Juragan Material, BRIK) pursued the same wedge in 2022. Supplier relationships and credit data could build stickiness but nothing structural existed at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy was found. Bukalapak had a building materials procurement service and general B2B platforms existed, but no incumbent bought Materee in the sources found.

market_need_then: The YC launch post describes manual price and stock checks, costly credit and unreliable delivery in a fragmented Indonesian construction supply chain. Construction is described as one of the most important Indonesian industries.

branding.domain_note: Uses materee.id, the Indonesian country domain, per the YC company page. Acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, mascot or community was found. The name is close to words like material, and search for the brand surfaced unrelated companies, but there is no evidence it affected outcomes.

outcome_analysis: Materee is active as of the sources found. Founders came from GudangAda, BCG's construction practice and Kargo Tech, which gave domain and engineering credibility. It raised a reported 3 million USD seed in June 2023 from Alpha JWC, January Capital and YC, in a year when several Indonesian construction materials marketplaces raised rounds. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found; outcome remains open.
notes: The company website materee.id could not be read by the fetch tool (empty result). The seed round is stated by DealStreetAsia (article dated 2023-06-20, text behind a registration wall, tags list Alpha JWC and YC) and by SeedTable, per search summaries; the 3 million figure and January Capital come from search summaries of those outlets. CB Insights shows 3.5 million across four rounds including a convertible note and angel money in September 2022; that is unverified and not recorded as rounds. Hansel is listed with a single name on the YC page. No outcome news found beyond directory listings.
